proofs.text: Run init on a pytest project, then `--add vitest`, and verify `test_framework` reads `pytest,vitest` with both plugins installed; run `--add vitest` once more and verify the value is unchanged

reasons: PROOF-32 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: `--add <framework>` keeps what was detected and records the framework once however many times it is added

tests.body:
def test_add_keeps_what_was_detected(self, project):
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        project.run('--add', 'vitest')
        assert project.config()['test_framework'] == 'pytest,vitest'
        assert project.has('.purlin/plugins/pytest_purlin.py')
        assert project.has('.purlin/plugins/vitest_purlin.ts')
tests.name: test_add_keeps_what_was_detected
